messages:
hana: Heads-up — onboarding run for zenika-v1 int6 shows a nasty drop on mixed-orientation translate suite (JA+ZH with ruby annotations + AR bidi). BLEU delta ~ -8.9 vs fp16 baseline.

noah: can you paste the eval summary + a failing example?

hana: pasted eval-bot summary below (suite mixed-orient-2026-03).

eval-bot: MODEL=zenika-v1-int6 | TASK=mixed-orient-translate | QUANT=int6
BLEU=23.1 (int6) vs 31.9 (fp16)
avg_tokens/sent: int6=16.2 | fp16=12.4
FAIL_RATE=0.11
example_input: "嵐(あらし) said سلام"
fp16_output: "嵐(あらし) said سلام"
int6_output: "嵐 said سلام"  (ruby reading dropped; parentheses repositioned)

wei: token length increased under int6 — classic sign of tokenizer fallback or normalization divergence.

akiko: were there any tokenizer/vocab tweaks during import? model artifact should be identical across quant runs.

hana: artifact unchanged. q4 and q8 runtimes produce near-baseline BLEU. regression reproduces only on int6 kernel path.

noah: repro steps i'll try:
- checkout zenika-v1
- run: `./eval --model zenika-v1-int6 --suite mixed-orient-2026-03 --save-fails`
- compare to: `./eval --model zenika-v1-fp16 --suite mixed-orient-2026-03`

hana: quick tokenization probe locally:
```
from tokenizer import Tokenizer
T = Tokenizer('zenika')
s = '嵐(あらし) said سلام'
print('fp16 len', len(T.encode(s, mode='fp16')) )
print('int6 len', len(T.encode(s, mode='int6')) )
```
-> fp16 len: 12
-> int6 len: 18

noah: you ran q4 too?
hana: yes — q4 BLEU 31.0 (close to fp16). int6 is the outlier.

wei: suspects: 1) preproc normalization table used by the int6 runtime; 2) fallback tokenization for codepoints above U+07FF; 3) detok glue algorithm using a different orientation-aware rule resulting in bracket reorder.

akiko: please dump token ids for the failing sample from both runs and diff them — that'll show split boundaries and if the Arabic segments were chunked.

hana: token id diffs uploaded to internal gist, linked in ticket. summary: int6 splits kana ruby readings into single-char tokens and fragments the Arabic word. total token count rises accordingly.

noah: i'm starting a bisect across int6 kernel commits (range 87a..9f2) to find where tokenization skew appears. will run tokenizer-only unit tests to isolate.

akiko: i'll add a deterministic detok roundtrip smoke for mixed-orient examples into onboarding CI so future model bringups fail fast for orientation/bracket reorder regressions.

hana: action items: 1) noah - bisect int6 kernels & produce a repro commit + script; 2) akiko - add tokenizer+detok smoke to onboarding CI; 3) wei - audit normalization tables and preproc branching in int6 runtime. Marking P0 for onboard quality hold.

eval-bot: created ticket ML-1229 with failing examples and CI artifacts: https://redwood.internal/ml/ML-1229

akiko: also notifying Dedicated infra — hold zenika int6 rollout until root cause fixed.

noah: ack. bisect started, will update with suspect commit and minimal repro in ~2h.

hana: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
